old: The debate engine's own manual: `engine_manual` (versioned; `select max(version)`);
new: The debate engine's own manual is held in parts in the table `engine_manual_parts`: `SELECT engine_manual_toc()` lists the parts, `SELECT engine_manual_part('<part>')` gives one, and `SELECT * FROM engine_manual_full()` gives the whole text and its version; the table `engine_manual` holds only the whole-text versions before the cut and a pointer row;

old: The writer sets `SET LOCAL truth.card = '<card label> <press time>Z <thread seat>'` in the same call
new: The writer sets `SET LOCAL truth.card = '<card label> <press time in Central time with its zone, for example 21:29 CST> <thread seat>'` in the same call

old: the engine manual is written only through engine_manual_apply.
new: the engine manual is written only through engine_manual_part_apply, one part at a time.
